nom: NUXE Huile Prodigieuse Florale Dry Body Oil for Skin & Hair

avis.titre: A True and Honest Unbiased Review
avis.texte: After reading what felt like a thousand reviews, I took the plunge to see for myself if the hype was real. It is not. PLEASE take my unbiased word for this. Here are some of the things I hoped might be true but really wasn't: 1. It would smell like this fresh, floral, unbelievably exotic French perfume. Reality: You get what you pay for. It smells like a cheap French over the counter beauty product which is basically what it is. And I've lived in Germany for three years and visited Paris with its perfume making factories. To be brutally honest, there are much better smelling American OTC products. This is not some cheap alternative for a French perfume if that's what you're hoping for against my better judgement like I was. 2. The fragrance would waft around me all throughout the day like a flowery cloud with everyone smelling the floral haze. One blogger claimed this and I bought this oil mostly because she made this claim. Reality: Nope, wrong again. The scent barely lasted an hour and I live in Texas where the heat should kick it up a notch. I've had Victoria Secret body lotions make more of a lasting impact. I really should've listened to the reviews who said it didn't last long. 3. It would make my skin somehow magically better. Reality: I think that basic virgin cold pressed coconut oil with a few drops of lavender or some other essential oil probably blows this oil out of the water. avis.titre: Lovely, light floral/citrusy scent, doesn't linger; non-greasy dry oil leaves my skin soft & smooth
avis.texte: I am new to this brand, and just bought the original version of this dry oil. I've heard about it for years and always wanted to try it but always thought it was a little out of my price range. I noticed the price dropped recently so I ordered it the other day. I like it a lot, although the fragrance is a little intense at first. It settles down nicely, though. So, I wanted to try this floral version too. I was a bit hesitant because some of the reviews mentioned a strong, linear, rose scent. And some of the reviews also seemed to indicate that the fragrance smelled a little old fashioned. Well, to me this oil has a light and very refreshing floral/citrusy fragrance that seems modern and isn't overpowering at all. The brand website describes the scent as grapefruit, magnolia and musk which seems spot on. No rose, nothing that smells unpleasant. I wonder if the formula has changed or some customers are receiving older stock. In any event, the oil I received smells nice and it goes on easily and leaves my skin feeling very soft and smooth. As a dry oil, it sinks right in and it feels very pampering with no oily feel + I just need a little bit. Theysprayer makes it easy to apply. The bottle is fairly heavy glass which is nice, but the sprayer and cap are kind of cheap and flimsy. I'm glad I tried this oil and I am finding it perfect for me to use right now in the heat of summer. I'll save the original version with its slightly heavier scent for fall.

avis.titre: Beautiful oil, a little too strong scent
avis.texte: It's a luxurious French rose oil and it's nice and dry on the skin. I only deduct one star because I think it's a little too scented... It's almost so strong it can give me a headache

avis.titre: Make it part of your princess routine NOW
avis.texte: Part of my Princess routine!! Great way to elevate your showering or body exfoliating experience. Not greasy and my husband says I smell amazing. The scent isn’t overpowering and with having very sensitive skin, no breakouts or rashes. I have this one and the original and swap out depending the mood.
Light floral fragrance, oil gives moisture and softness without just laying on skin. I will purchase again.

avis.titre: Puts down that hag hair, calms the flyaways with a lovely scent.
avis.texte: Lovely light scent. Oil is lighter weight than some of the other NUXE choices. After a face wash, the oil goes on smoothing summer skin nicely. i love the effect of the many healthy ingredients. The floral scent is especially nice on my flyaway hair.

I didn't care for the floral scent at first, but it's grown on me a lot because it lessens as it dries and you have a lovely mix of the musk and light floral. The quality of this dry oil mist is as excellent as ever. Please offer the Neroli on here because I want to try it next.
J’adore ce produit, non gras et une odeur hyper agréable. Livraison rapide comme d’habitude

I was looking for a dry body oil for my wedding day as I wanted my skin to be glowing, this product delivered and more. It smells SO GOOD in the most natural way possible, it doesn't smell synthetic. The oil applies on oily but it eventually absorbs and the skin does not feel sticky or oily I promise you. I wore a white wedding dress as well so I was panicking a bit as some oils stain clothing, but this doesn't. You can also use this on your hair omg I love a 2-in-1 product, it smells so good did I already mention that? haha I am so happy! I might add this as a staple to my dressing table

avis.titre: J’en ai déjà acheté, j’en rachète et je pense continuer à en racheter
avis.texte: Très bonne huile qui prenait dans la peau rend la peau très douce. Vous pouvez me mettre sur vos cheveux une application assez pour les cheveux qui sont assez secs. Niveau prix beaucoup beaucoup moins cher que dans le commerce en Pharmacie ou outre et l’odeur floral est magnifique.

avis.titre: It is a for sure a keeper.
avis.texte: Just got it couldn’t wait to try. I applied some to my arms to test run and noticed it doesn’t leave you feeling greasy in anyway. I can definitely see this as a good body and hair product but will not be using it on my face as I prefer non fragrant products for my facial moisturizer. I will say the fact it doesn’t leave you feeling greasy and leaving fingerprints is a nice change of pace. The scent is strong in the beginning with floral but when it settles in it’s light and breezy with citrus undertones. It’s very pleasant and rounded. I do plan on trying more from this brand for sure, the quality is very noticeable right away and would suggest it to anyone looking.
But it, just buy it. It smells like a high end perfume store in the provinces of France. Smells like the inside of Fragonard. IYKYK Leaves my skin super soft and scent is long lasting.

avis.titre: Extremely moisturizing better than the original
avis.texte: I love how moisturized my skin looks & feels and not only that it smells amazing! Paired with my perfume and body wash this oil makes my skin feel magical. Just what I needed. The perfect spring scent✨🌹💫
I really like this oil. It has a wonderful smell and it does not make the skin greasy, but moisturizes. The only thing is that it came to me with a crumpled lid (I could no longer give it as a gift).

I bought this because I have a very Afro puffy hair, which gets very moisture during summertime. This works perfectly for my type of hair. The perfume does contain oil which makes the hair shiny as well. LOVE IT
This smells amazing but the bottle was shipped without a cap and it has definitely been used prior to my purchase. Came with oil all over it. Hoping the replacement will be an actual new bottle
I'm a fan of the original scent, but she's in heaven with this one. Happy MIL. Happy wife.

avis.titre: Possibly a used bottle was sent to me
avis.texte: Two starts because it smells beautiful, but when I opened the packaging. I immediately noticed it came almost a 1/3 of the way empty . Like it’s been used already. Very disappointed.
The spray know to make the nozzle work. I can't spray anymore.
This was delivered wrapped just in plastic with the barcode printed, cut and taped on? And this note was printed and glued on the ingriedients… the smell is off as well. Is this real? Just old?
